prompt_fragment: This asset is a sprite. Keep the silhouette clean and readable, with one clear focal subject and strong separation from the background.
raw_description:
A Before Times relic held in an Aurora Stack deepest vault — an
impossible shard of uncertain material whose surface shifts between
states, edges impossibly sharp. Serial numbers ("8H-H1Y0B") are incised
into its face in faintly phosphorescent script in a language no one alive
can read. Resting on a carved volcanic-glass pedestal. Aurora-crystal
shards arranged in a warding pattern around the pedestal. A cold
wrongness halo around the relic — the ice-memory itself recoils.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor on aged parchment, a shifting impossible relic shard resting on a carved volcanic-glass pedestal surrounded by aurora-crystal warding shards, vellum cream and slate ink shadow punctuated by cold prismatic ember glints.

subjects.description: Impossible angular shard, surface shifting between glassy and matte states, edges razored and precise, incised serial numbers '8H-H1Y0B' in faintly phosphorescent script, cold wrongness rendered as a dense gravitational haze pressing outward from its form
subjects.position: centered, elevated on pedestal, dominant focal mass
